overview.brief: Fortified keep overlooking Highpass Hold (tools page title: Highpass Keep). Upper civilized areas; lower passages with Pickclaw goblins, prisoners, smugglers, and rogues. EQ Legends Tools recommends 25–30. Wiki Recommended Levels lists High Keep as City 20–30.

research_notes.firecrawl: CLI not authenticated this session; used curl of same primary URLs. Outputs saved under .firecrawl/
research_notes.spawn_policy: Batch 3 deferred spawn deep-dive; spawn.known=false / notes="mob location unknown" unless trivial on same page (none were).
research_notes.level_gaps: Najena (NPC) appears in inventory under High Keep but is not leveled on the Highpass Keep tools page (likely cross-zone contamination); left null.
research_notes.access_keys: No zone-entry keys cataloged on tools page. Wiki mentions a quest key for a locked room (Tearon's Skeleton) — not treated as zone access.
